summary: Frontend tests on mobile web (390x844, Pro). Heute-Übersicht and Termin work: 'Heute' + 08:30 saved, shown under Termine as '08:30 Uhr' and sorted by time; tomorrow's Termin not listed; Entfernen works; 'Heute bearbeitet' max 5, no duplicates, archived hidden; tapping a row opens the project. 'Projekte' tile is gone and the other 7 tiles are present. Drag-to-folder moved projects correctly (fA/fB, Ohne Ordner, Neuer Ordner via prompt, persists after reload, release outside does nothing). One CRITICAL bug: every drag or long-press release also fired the card's onPress. A drop navigated to /projects/<id>, and a still long-press entered selection but left the card unselected (toggled twice). I fixed it in projects/index.tsx and verified it. Remaining: the drop panel renders underneath the list header (z-order). Projektart regression works.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY T1: The TouchableOpacity onPress fired on mouse-up after the RNGH Pan gesture. Any drop (also outside the targets) opened the project detail. Drop on 'Neuer Ordner' showed the name prompt on top of the detail screen. A long press without moving entered selection mode, but the card ended up unselected because onPress toggled it again. Reproduced 4/4 times. Fix: add onLongPress={() => {}} delayLongPress={400} to the card. Pressability then suppresses onPress after a long press. Verified: drop stays on /projects, long press selects the card, normal tap still navigates.

The overlay is rendered as the first child of the container with absoluteFill and no zIndex or elevation. Later siblings (archive-suggest-banner, search bar, chips) paint on top of the drop panel and the ghost card. elementFromPoint at the center of drop-target-fB returned 'archive-suggest-banner', and the screenshot shows the targets hidden behind the banner and search bar. Drops still work, because hit-testing uses the measured rects, but the user cannot see the targets. Reference: app/projects/index.tsx:1676, FolderDropOverlay.tsx:50
The regex /^\d{1,2}:\d{2}$/ accepts invalid times: '25:99' was saved and shown as '25:99 Uhr'. Reference: AppointmentPicker.tsx:39
An unparseable date such as 'abc' silently falls back to the previous or today's date without feedback. '31.02.2026' would roll over to March via new Date. Reference: AppointmentPicker.tsx:35-38

issues: The Projektart 'Datum' picker shows an empty modal on web (only Löschen/Fertig) because DateTimePicker is not supported on web. This existed before and is not caused by this change; AppointmentPicker already handles web with a TextInput.

action_items: Review and keep T1's fix in app/projects/index.tsx: onLongPress={() => {}} delayLongPress={400} on the project card TouchableOpacity. Optionally align it to 450ms to remove the 400-450ms dead zone where a release does nothing.
Render FolderDropOverlay above the list: move it after the FlatList in the JSX, or give its root zIndex: 1000 and elevation: 20. Re-check at 390px with the archive banner visible.
AppointmentPicker: validate hours 0-23 and minutes 0-59. Show an error for an invalid or unparseable TT.MM.JJJJ date, and reject rollover dates instead of saving silently.
critical_code_review_comments: makeDragGesture(item) builds a new Gesture object for every card on every render (including each dragPos update during a drag). Consider memoizing per item, or a single gesture with item lookup, for long lists.
TodayOverview's date and todayKey are computed per render; the card does not refresh at midnight if the app stays open (minor).
Setting a Termin bumps updated_at. A project with a Termin tomorrow therefore also appears under 'Heute bearbeitet' today. This is consistent with the spec, just noting it.

rca_of_issue: On web, RNGH Pan activation does not cancel the RN-web Pressability press on the underlying TouchableOpacity. Because the card no longer had onLongPress, Pressability treated mouse-up after any hold as a press and called onPress. That navigated to the project, or toggled the selection a second time. Adding an onLongPress handler makes Pressability skip onPress once the long-press delay has passed. Verified in the browser after hot reload.
